crossRefs.note: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.
Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

parallels.note: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

translations.web: It was the third hour, and they crucified him.
translations.bsb: It was the third hour when they crucified Him.
translations.kjv: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
translations.asv: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
